prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the passenger in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1060; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision in Conroe, Texas. Can you confirm you're comfortable being recorded?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Where were you sitting at the time of the collision?

A: I was in the front passenger seat. My friend was driving.

Q: Can you describe what was happening right before impact?

A: We were on the highway and my friend signaled to move into the left lane. A vehicle in that lane was coming up fast. As we started to move over, that car clipped the side of ours. It pushed us toward the median and we spun a little before stopping.

Q: Did either vehicle stop at the scene?

A: No, the other driver kept going. We got the plate partially, but not the whole thing.

Q: Tell me about your injuries.

A: My right knee hit the dashboard hard. It swelled up within an hour and I could barely put weight on it. I went to an urgent care clinic that same day and they took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic doctor.

Q: Have you been seen by a specialist since then?

A: Yes, I had an MRI and I'm now doing physical therapy twice a week. The doctor mentioned a possible torn meniscus, but they're still evaluating it.

Q: Are you currently experiencing any limitations?

A: Yes. Stairs are difficult, and I've had to stop working my shifts on my feet. I'm still getting used to the brace.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I want to make sure the other driver's information gets recorded properly, since they left the scene.

Q: Understood. Thank you for your time today.
